name: tui-kit
description: Host-free terminal UI kit for Claude Code mods, shipped as a copy-in template of pure ES modules: semantic colour tokens mapped to the host's theme-key names (adaptive and complete variants, derived shades, remappable tier colours), an accessibility profile built from plain host values, NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR handling, control-sequence sanitising, and a status badge rendered to plain text, ANSI and markdown from one definition. Ships no hooks, skills or agents; installing it changes nothing until a mod copies the kit in.
